name: Dolores C. Rivera
office: Bassett Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Dolores C. Rivera is a member of the Bassett Unified School District Governing Board. She says she worked in the district for 25 years as a community liaison. She says she was also a PTA leader. She wants to bring more mental health agencies into the district to serve students.
